topics.title: a / an (Belirsiz Article)
topics.notes:
Karar **yazıya değil okunuşa** göre verilir.

| Okunuşu | Article | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Sessiz harf sesiyle başlar | **a** | a company, a book, **a university** (/ju:/ sesi) |
| Sesli harf sesiyle başlar | **an** | an animal, an apple, **an hour** (h okunmaz) |

topics.title: Çoğul ve -s Takısı Yazımı (-ies)
topics.notes:
| Kelime sonu | Kural | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **sessiz harf + y** | y düşer → **-ies** | city → cities, study → studies |
| **sesli harf + y** | sadece **-s** | play → plays, boy → boys |
| -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o | **-es** | wash → washes, fix → fixes, go → goes |

⚠️ Düzeltme: "play → plays" örneği **ies kuralına girmez**; y'den önce sesli harf (a) olduğu için sadece -s alır.

topics.title: Günler, Aylar ve Zaman Edatları
topics.notes:
**Günler:** Monday – Tuesday – **Wednesday** – Thursday – Friday – Saturday – Sunday
⚠️ Yazım: Wednesday (wendesday ❌). Gün ve ay isimleri **büyük harfle** başlar.

**Aylar:** January – February – March – April – May – June – July – August – September – October – November – December

| Edat | Ne ile | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **at** | saat | at 7 o'clock, at night |
| **on** | gün / tarih | on Monday, on 5 May |
| **in** | ay, yıl, mevsim, gün parçası | in June, in 2024, in summer, in the evening |

topics.title: Geniş Zaman (Present Simple)
topics.notes:
Cümle yapısı: **özne + yüklem + nesne**

| | I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | I **work** | He **works** (fiile -s) |
| Olumsuz | I **don't** (do not) work | He **doesn't** (does not) work |
| Soru | **Do** you work? | **Does** he work? |

- he/she/it olumsuz ve soruda **does** gelir ve fiilin **-s takısını kendine çeker**: He doesn't work (works ❌), Does he work? (works ❌)
- **does sadece soru ve olumsuzda** kullanılır.
- am/is/are (to be) ve have/has de geniş zamanda kullanılır.
- **have / has olumsuz:** don't have / doesn't have
  - **have got / has got olumsuz:** haven't got / hasn't got
  - I don't have a car = I haven't got a car.

### Kısa cevaplar
- A: **Do** you work as a computer programmer? B: Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**.
- A: **Does** he study at university? B: Yes, he **does**. / No, he **doesn't**.

⚠️ Düzeltme: "Does you he study" → **Does he study**. Yapı: **Do/Does + özne + yalın fiil ...?**

topics.title: Sıklık Zarfları
topics.notes:
always – usually – often – sometimes – seldom/rarely – never

| Konum | Örnek |
|---|---|
| özne + sıklık zarfı + fiil | I **always** get up early. |
| to be'den **sonra** | She **is always** late. |
| ifadeler (every day, once a week) başta veya sonda | **Every day** I walk. / I walk **every day**. |

topics.title: Soru Kelimeleri ile Geniş Zaman
topics.notes:
Yapı: **Soru kelimesi + do/does + özne + yalın fiil?**

| Soru | Cevap |
|---|---|
| When do you get up? | At 7 am. |
| When does he watch TV? | In the evening. |
| Where do you live? | In Ankara. |
| Where does she work? | She **works** at a factory. |
| What time do you get up? | At 7 am. |
| What time does he watch TV? | He **watches** TV at ten o'clock. |
| What do you buy in the shopping mall? | I buy clothes. |
| What does he play every week? | He plays chess. |
| Who do you live with? | My parents. |
| Who does she meet every day? | She meets her friends every day. |
| Why do you work? | Because I need money. |
| Why does she read books? | To learn new things. |
| How do you go to work? | By bus. |
| How does **he earn** money? | By working hard. |
| How often do you watch TV? | I watch **it** every evening. |
| How often does she eat pizza? | Usually. / Once a week. |

⚠️ Düzeltmeler: "she workd" → **she works**; "How does earns money" → **How does he earn money** (özne eksikti, does varken fiil yalın).

topics.title: -s Takısının Okunuşu
topics.notes:
| Fiil sonu | Okunuş | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Sert ünsüz (f, s, t, k, c, ş, h, p) | /s/ | walks, works, stops |
| Yumuşak ünsüz ve sesli | /z/ | plays (/pleyz/), runs (/ranz/) |
| -es (s, sh, ch, x sonrası) | /ız/ | washes (/woşız/), fixes (/fiksız/) |

topics.title: Renkler / What color + there is / there are
topics.notes:
- Renk sorusu: **What color** is your car? → It's red.
- **there is** + tekil = var: There **is** a cat in the garden. Soru: **Is there** a cat?
- **there are** + çoğul = var: There **are** two cats. Soru: **Are there** any cats?
- **What do you feel like** (doing)? = Canın ne yapmak istiyor?

topics.title: Şimdiki Zaman (Present Continuous)
topics.notes:
Yapı: **am / is / are + fiil-ing**

| Biçim | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Olumlu | I **am working**. |
| Olumsuz | I **am not** working. / You **aren't** reading. / She **isn't** sleeping. |
| Evet/hayır sorusu (be başa) | **Are** you reading a book now? / **Is** she playing tennis? |
| Wh- sorusu (soru kelimesi + be + özne) | Where **are** you studying? / Why **are** they smiling? |

**Gelecek plan anlamı:** Present Continuous, kesinleşmiş yakın gelecek planları için de kullanılır.
- I'm flying to Rome next week.

⚠️ Düzeltme: Notta "-ing eki ile geniş zaman da kullanılır" yazıyordu; doğrusu **şimdiki zamanın gelecek plan anlamı** (geniş zaman değil).

topics.title: Action Verbs vs State Verbs ⭐ (önemli)
topics.notes:
| Tür | -ing alır mı? | Örnekler |
|---|---|---|
| Action (hareket) | ✅ am/is/are + -ing | work, talk, go, sleep, run, listen, read |
| State (durum) | ❌ geniş zaman kalır | want, know, believe, need, love, see, understand |

- I **am reading** now. ✅ / I **know** the answer. ✅ (I am knowing ❌)
- **have**:
  - sahiplik (durum) → -ing almaz: I **have** a car.
  - hareket (yemek, banyo vs.) → -ing alır: I **am having** breakfast.

topics.title: think (fikir) vs think about (düşünmek)
topics.notes:
| Anlam | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Fikrim bu / bence | think (that) — -ing **almaz** | I **think** (that) the world is small. |
| Bir şeyi düşünmek | think about — -ing **alabilir** | I **am thinking about** my exams now. |

Sorularda da aynı mantık: What do you think? (fikir) / What are you thinking about? (şu an düşündüğün)

topics.title: would like
topics.notes:
Daha **kibar** istemek için: I **would like** some water = I want some water (daha kibar).

- Kısaltma: I'd like
- Fiil gelirse **to** gelir: I would like **to drink** some water. (want to gibi)
- Soru: **Would** + özne + **like**...? → Would you like some water? → Yes, please. / Yes, I would.
- Would you like **to go out** tonight? → No, thanks.

⚠️ **would like = istemek**, **like = sevmek/hoşlanmak**: I like coffee (severim) / I'd like a coffee (bir kahve isterim).

topics.title: Özne ve Nesne Zamirleri
topics.notes:
| Özne | Nesne | Aitlik |
|---|---|---|
| I | me | my |
| you | you | your |
| he | him | his |
| she | her | her |
| it | it | its |
| we | us | our |
| they | them | their |

Nesne olarak kullanım:
- I am a student → My parents love **me**.
- You are smart → People admire **you**.
- He is great → We trust **him**.
- She lives in a small town → Her friends sometimes visit **her**.

**know** = bilmek / tanımak: I know the answer. / I know him.

topics.title: a/an vs the (Belirsiz – Belirli Article)
topics.notes:
- Belirsiz (ilk kez söz edilen) → **a/an**; belirli (bilinen, daha önce geçen) → **the**
  - Carol is in **a** garden. / Carol is in **the** garden.
  - There is **a** dog in the garden. **The** dog is running after **a** cat. **The** cat is running after **a** mouse. **The** mouse is very fast.
- Tek olan varlıklar **the** alır: the sun, the moon, the sky, the king, the queen, the weather
- **Genellemelerde article yok:** Apples are good for you. / Rice is important for our economy. / Students always do their homework.

topics.title: Belgisiz Zamirler
topics.notes:
| | some- (olumlu) | any- (olumsuz/soru; olumluda "herhangi") | no- (olumlu cümlede "hiç") |
|---|---|---|---|
| kişi | someone / somebody (birisi) | anyone / anybody | no one / nobody (hiç kimse) |
| şey | something (bir şey) | anything | nothing (hiçbir şey) |
| yer | somewhere (bir yer) | anywhere | nowhere (hiçbir yer) |

- Olumsuzda: I don't know **anyone**. = I know **no one**.
- Olumluda any = herhangi: You can sit **anywhere**.
- ⚠️ no- zaten olumsuz: I know **nothing** ✅ / I don't know nothing ❌

topics.title: Geçmiş Zaman (Past Simple)
topics.notes:
### to be → was / were
| Özne | was/were |
|---|---|
| I / he / she / it | **was** |
| you / we / they | **were** |

- I am a student → I **was** a student.
- You are beautiful this evening → You **were** beautiful yesterday evening.
- Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't. Soru: **Was** he...? / **Were** you...?

### Normal fiiller
| Biçim | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu (düzenli) | fiil + **-ed** | I walked. |
| Olumlu (düzensiz) | **V2** | I slept eight hours last night. |
| Olumsuz | **didn't + yalın fiil** | I didn't walk to school yesterday. |
| Soru | **Did + özne + yalın fiil?** | Did you talk to your teacher yesterday? → Yes, I did. |

⚠️ Hareket (eylem) varsa **did**, durum (sıfat, isim, yer) varsa **was/were**:
- Did you **go** there? / **Were** you tired?

### Düzensiz fiiller (başlangıç)
| V1 | V2 |
|---|---|
| go | went |
| sleep | **slept** |
| buy | bought |
| take | took |
| get | got |
| have | had |
| know | knew |
| speak | spoke |

⚠️ Düzeltme: sleot → **slept**, yesterdeay → yesterday.

topics.title: Who / What Soruları (özne mi nesne mi?)
topics.notes:
| Ne soruluyor | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Özne** (eylemi yapan) | Who + V2 (did YOK) | Mike bought a car last year. → **Who bought** a car last year? |
| **Nesne** (eylemden etkilenen) | Who/What + did + özne + yalın fiil | I met Carol at a cafe. → **Who did you meet** at a cafe? |

- What did you eat last night? → A cake.
- **What vs Which:** what = seçenek belirsiz/açık; which = sınırlı seçenekler arasından.
  - What did you eat? / Which cake did you eat, the chocolate one or the lemon one?

topics.title: Faydalı Kalıplar
topics.notes:
| Kalıp | Anlam |
|---|---|
| Have you ever been abroad? | Hiç yurt dışına gittin mi? |
| Although it can be a little expensive... | Biraz pahalı olabilse de... |
| May I help you? | Yardımcı olabilir miyim? |
| New models have come. | Yeni modeller geldi. |
| I guess... | Sanırım... |
| Let me see... | Bir bakayım / Dur düşüneyim... |
| What do you feel like doing? | Canın ne yapmak istiyor? |

---

*A1 notlarından derlendi. Eksik konular ayrıca toplanacak.*

topics.title: To be vs Normal Fiil (Geniş Zaman)
topics.notes:
Geniş zamanın iki hâli vardır:

| | to be ile (am/is/are) | normal fiil ile |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | She **is** happy | She **works** |
| Olumsuz | She **isn't** happy | She **doesn't** work |
| Soru | **Is** she happy? | **Does** she work? |

**Dikkat:** to be varsa do/does KULLANILMAZ.
- Is she happy? ✅ / Does she be happy? ❌
- am/is/are üç yerde gelir: (1) Present Continuous (-ing), (2) be going to,
  (3) tek başına asıl fiil (I am a student).

topics.title: Tüm Zamanların Cümle Yapıları
topics.notes:
**Geniş (Present Simple)**
- Olumlu: Özne + yüklem (+s) → I play / He plays
- Olumsuz: don't/doesn't + fiil → I don't play / He doesn't play
- Soru: Do/Does + özne + fiil? → Does he play?

**Şimdiki (Present Continuous)**
- Olumlu: am/is/are + fiil-ing → I am playing
- Olumsuz: am/is/are + not + fiil-ing → I am not playing
- Soru: Am/Is/Are + özne + fiil-ing? → Are you playing?

**Geçmiş (Past Simple)**
- Olumlu: fiil-ed / V2 → I played / I went
- Olumsuz: didn't + yalın fiil → I didn't play
- Soru: Did + özne + yalın fiil? → Did you play?

**Gelecek – will**
- Olumlu: will + yalın fiil → I will play
- Olumsuz: won't + fiil → I won't play
- Soru: Will + özne + fiil? → Will you play?

**Gelecek – be going to**
- Olumlu: am/is/are + going to + fiil → I am going to play
- Olumsuz: am/is/are + not + going to + fiil → I'm not going to play
- Soru: Am/Is/Are + özne + going to + fiil? → Are you going to play?

**Dikkat:**
- Past/Future'da soru/olumsuzda fiil YALIN: didn't played ❌, will plays ❌
- Cümlede -ing gördüğünde → am/is/are ara (What **are** you doing?)

topics.title: "What + do" Soru Yapısı
topics.notes:
"What" ile sorulan sorularda cevap = yapılan eylem (fiil).

| Soru | Zaman | Cevap |
|---|---|---|
| What do you do (every day)? | Geniş | I go to school. |
| What are you doing (now)? | Şimdiki | I am reading. |
| What did you do (yesterday)? | Geçmiş | I played football. |
| What will you do (tomorrow)? | Gelecek | I will visit my friend. |

**Dikkat:** What do you do? = meslek/rutin. What are you doing? = şu an.

topics.title: will / may / might / maybe
topics.notes:
| Kelime | Anlam | Kesinlik |
|---|---|---|
| will | kesinlikle olacak | ~%100 |
| may / might | olabilir de olmayabilir de | ~%50 |
| maybe | belki | ~%50 |

- may / might + YALIN fiil: It **may/might rain**. He **might be** at home.
- maybe → cümlenin başına gelir, will'i düşürmez: **Maybe** she **will** come.
- Aynı anlam iki yolla: We **might not** go = **Maybe** we **will not** go.

**Dikkat:** maybe (tek kelime = belki) ≠ may be (iki kelime = olabilir)
- Maybe he is tired. / He may be tired.

topics.title: Zaman Cümlecikleri (before / after / when)
topics.notes:
### ⚠️ EN ÖNEMLİ KURAL
**before / after / when'den sonra ASLA "will" gelmez.**
"will" sadece ana cümlede yaşar.

### Üç kalıp (iki taraf aynı "zaman dünyasında" olur)

| Zaman dünyası | Ana cümle | before/after sonrası | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| Geçmiş | Past | Past | I called her after she **went** home. |
| Gelecek | will / going to | **Present Simple** | I will call her after she **goes** home. |
| Genel alışkanlık | Present | Present | I call her after she **gets** home. |

**Karışık zaman (present+past, past+future) OLMAZ** — zaman uyumu vardır.

### Konum kuralı
Zaman cümlesi başa da sona da gelebilir. **Başa gelirse virgül** konur.
- He will go out **before** I call him.
- **Before** I call him, he will go out.

### before/after anlam (Türkçe)
- before'dan sonraki olay = daha GEÇ olan
- after'dan sonraki olay = daha ERKEN olan
- Kural: before/after hangi cümleye yapışıksa, o cümle Türkçede "-den önce/sonra"
  olur ve başa gelir.

topics.title: Koşul Cümleleri (zero / first / second)
topics.notes:
| Tip | Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zero | present + present | genel doğru | If you heat ice, it **melts**. |
| First | present + will | gerçek, olası | If I study, I **will** pass. |
| Second | past + would + V1 | hayali, gerçek dışı | If I **were** rich, I **would** live in Europe. |

**Dikkat:**
- if tarafında ASLA will yok (before/after kuralının aynısı):
  If it **rains**, you will get wet. (if it will rain ❌)
- Second conditional'da tüm öznelerde **were**: If I **were** you...
- Second conditional'da sonuç kısmında **would**'u atma:
  If I were rich, I **would buy** a car. (I bought ❌)
- would = "zaman" değil, "gerçek değil / hayali" etiketidir (-dım/-saydım hissi).

topics.title: Ability (can / could / be able to)
topics.notes:
- can → şimdiki/genel yetenek: I **can** swim.
- could → geçmiş genel yetenek: I **could** swim when I was four.
- be able to → can/could ile aynı, tüm kişilerde: I **am able to** / I **was able to**

### ⚠️ could vs was able to

| Durum | could | was/were able to |
|---|---|---|
| Genel yetenek (geçmiş) | ✅ | ✅ |
| Tek seferlik başarı ("başardı") | ❌ | ✅ |
| Olumsuz | couldn't ✅ | wasn't able to ✅ |

- Genel: I could swim = I was able to swim.
- Tek seferlik başarı: The exam was hard, but I **was able to** pass it.
  (could ❌ — "başarmak" anlamı)
- Olumsuzda ayrım kaybolur: couldn't = wasn't able to.

**Telaffuz:** olumlu "can" yutuk (/kın/), "can't" net ve vurgulu (/kænt/).

topics.title: very / too
topics.notes:
- **very** = çok (sorun yok, iş olur) → genelde **but** ile
- **too** = aşırı (sorun var, iş olmaz) → genelde **so** ile

| Cümle | Anlam |
|---|---|
| This box is **very** heavy, **but** I can lift it. | ağır ama kaldırırım |
| This box is **too** heavy, **so** I can't lift it. | o kadar ağır ki kaldıramam |

### too ... to yapıları
- **too + sıfat + to + fiil** = yapamayacak kadar...
  He is **too short to play** basketball.
- **too + sıfat + for + kişi + to + fiil**
  This box is **too heavy for him to lift**.

⚠️ **Kuyruk kesme:** to + fiil'den sonra HİÇBİR ŞEY gelmez (özne/nesne tekrar edilmez).
- too heavy to lift ✅ / too heavy to lift **it** ❌

### too much / too many
- too much + sayılamayan: too much **water**
- too many + sayılabilen (çoğul): too many **people**

topics.title: enough
topics.notes:
| Yapı | Sıra | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| sıfat + enough | enough SONRA | old **enough** |
| enough + isim | enough ÖNCE | **enough** money |

- sıfat + enough + to + fiil = yapabilecek kadar...: old enough **to** vote
- enough + (for + kişi) + to + fiil: light enough **for me to** carry

**enough = too'nun zıttı:**
- too young **to** drive (çok genç, süremez)
- old enough **to** drive (yeterince büyük, sürebilir)

**Dikkat:** enough old ❌ → old enough ✅. money enough ❌ → enough money ✅.

topics.title: Modal + Yalın Fiil Kuralı
topics.notes:
Modal'lar: **can, could, may, might, will, would, must, should**
Hepsinden sonra fiil YALIN gelir — ek almaz:

- -s almaz: She can **swim** (swims ❌)
- -ing almaz: May I **use** (using ❌)
- to almaz: I will **go** (to go ❌)
- V2 almaz: He could **swim** (swam ❌)

Sebep: modal cümlenin gramer yükünü taşır, fiil sade kalır.

topics.title: Polite Requests (may / could / can / would)
topics.notes:
**İzin isterken (I):** Can I *(samimi)* → Could I → **May I** *(en resmî)*
**Rica ederken (you):** Can you *(samimi)* → Could you → **Would you** *(en kibar)*

- May **I** use your phone? (izin)
- Could/Would **you** open the door? (rica)

⚠️ **may sadece "I" ile.** "May you...?" YANLIŞ. Başkasından isterken → Would/Could/Can you.
Modal'dan sonra fiil yalın (bkz. 10): Can you **pass** me...? (passing ❌)
- **pass me** = (bana) uzatmak: Could you pass me the salt?
- Kısa cevaplar: Yes, of course. / Sure.

topics.title: Emir Cümleleri (Imperatives)
topics.notes:
- **Özne yoktur** (gizli "you"). Fiil yalın başlar.
- Olumlu: **Come** here. / **Close** the window.
- Olumsuz: **Don't** + fiil → **Don't** come here.
- please ile yumuşatılır (başa ya da sona; sonda virgülle):
  **Please** help me. / Help me, **please**.

**Dikkat:** olumsuz her zaman **Don't** (doesn't/didn't ❌). Özne koyma (You come here ❌).

topics.title: Sıfat Sıralaması (OSASCOM) + İsim Tamlaması
topics.notes:
### Sıfat sırası: OSASCOM
**O**pinion → **S**ize → **A**ge → **S**hape → **C**olor → **O**rigin → **M**aterial → İSİM

| Sıra | Kategori | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Opinion (görüş) | beautiful, expensive |
| 2 | Size (boyut) | big, small |
| 3 | Age (yaş) | new, old |
| 4 | Shape (şekil) | round, square |
| 5 | Color (renk) | red, black |
| 6 | Origin (köken) | Chinese, French |
| 7 | Material (malzeme) | silk, wooden |

- a **beautiful small old black** desk
- **Dikkat:** Size, Age'den önce (small old ✅, old small ❌)
- Sesli sesle başlayan sıfattan önce **an**: **an** old chair, **an** expensive car

### İsim + İsim Tamlaması
İlk isim sıfat gibi davranır, ikinci ismi niteler; **ilk isim TEKİL kalır.**
- a **grammar** book, a **car** key, a **shoe** shop (shoes shop ❌)

topics.title: all of / most of / some of / one of / none of
topics.notes:
**Yapı: miktar + of the + isim**

| İsim türü | isim | fiil |
|---|---|---|
| Sayılabilir (çoğul) | -s (cars) | **are** |
| Sayılamaz | yalın (water) | **is** |

- all of (hepsi) → most of (çoğu) → some of (bazısı) → none of (hiçbiri)

⚠️ **one of the → isim ÇOĞUL ama fiil TEKİL (is):**
- One of the notebook**s** **is** beautiful.
- none of the → resmî kullanımda **is**.
- almost = neredeyse: almost all of the food.

**Dikkat:** "of" varsa "the" de gelir: all of **the** students (all of students ❌).
Ya "of the" birlikte, ya ikisi de yok (all students).

topics.title: every / everyone / everybody / everything
topics.notes:
**Hepsi TEKİL davranır → daima "is".**

| Kalıp | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| every | every + tekil isim | Every student **is** here. |
| every one of / each of | ...of the + çoğul isim | Every one of the students **is** here. |
| everyone / everybody | tek kelime (herkes) | Everyone **is** here. |
| everything | tek kelime (her şey) | Everything **is** ready. |

**Dikkat:**
- every + TEKİL isim (every students ❌)
- everyone (bitişik = herkes) vs every one (ayrı = her biri, of ile): every one **of**...

topics.title: Aitlik Yapıları (Possessives)
topics.notes:
### Possessive Adjective vs Pronoun

| Adjective (isimden ÖNCE) | Pronoun (tek başına) |
|---|---|
| my book | mine |
| your car | yours |
| his pen | his |
| her bag | hers |
| its tail | its |
| our chairs | ours |
| their classes | theirs |

- This is **my** car. (my + isim) / This car is **mine**. (tek başına)

### Kesme işareti ('s / ')

| Durum | Kural | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Tekil isim | 's | Mike**'s**, Sarah**'s** |
| Çoğul (-s'li) isim | sadece ' | the students**'** |
| Düzensiz çoğul | 's | the children**'s** |
| -s ile biten özel isim | ' veya 's | Chris**'** / Chris**'s** |

⚠️ **Zamirler ASLA kesme almaz:** mine, yours, his, hers, ours, **theirs**
(their's ❌, her's ❌)

- **whose** = kimin (aitlik sorar): Whose bag is this? — It's mine.
- his = erkek, hers = kadın.

topics.title: Doğrudan ve Dolaylı Nesneler
topics.notes:
- Direct object (düz nesne) = eylemden etkilenen şey (a letter)
- Indirect object (dolaylı nesne) = kime/kimin için (Michael)

| Diziliş | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| 1. yol | fiil + direct + to/for + indirect | I wrote a letter **to** Michael. |
| 2. yol | fiil + indirect + direct | I wrote **Michael** a letter. |

- **to** → ulaşma (give, send, write, tell, show): gave the book **to** her
- **for** → yarar (make, buy, cook, get): made a cake **for** her
- 2. yola çevirince to/for kalkar: gave **her** the book / made **her** a cake

⚠️ **Direct object ZAMİRSE (it, them) → çevrilmez (N/A):**
- I sent **them** to Alison. ✅ (I sent Alison them ❌)
- He gave **it** to her. ✅ (He gave her it ❌)

**Dikkat:** "bize/bizi" = us (our = bizim, aitlik — farklı). Made **us** a cake.

topics.title: for vs to
topics.notes:
**Kural: arkasında isim → for, fiil → to.**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| for + isim | I opened the door **for Kate**. |
| to + yalın fiil (amaç) | I came here **to learn** English. |

- to → ulaşma/amaç; in order to = to (daha resmî): ...**in order to** get a job.
- to (bir şey için): give a present **to** my sister
- for (birinin yararına): buy a gift **for** you

⚠️ **Amaç bir fiilse ASLA for kullanma:** to learn ✅ (for learn ❌)

topics.title: Karşılaştırmalar (same / similar / different / like / alike)
topics.notes:
İki şeyi karşılaştırırken kullanılan kalıplar. Kritik nokta: bazıları
**nesne alır (to/as/from ile)**, bazıları **tek başına sona gelir**.

| Kalıp | Anlam | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| the same **as** | aynı | ...+ as + nesne | My shirt is the same **as** yours. |
| the same | aynı | iki özne + are the same | My car and yours **are the same**. |
| similar **to** | benzer | ...+ to + nesne | My car is similar **to** your car. |
| similar | benzer | iki özne + are similar | My book and your book **are similar**. |
| different **from** | farklı | ...+ from + nesne | My chair is different **from** yours. |
| different | farklı | iki özne + are different | Our houses **are different**. |

**Mantık:**
- Tek nesneyle karşılaştırma → **the same as / similar to / different from** (bağlaç şart).
- İki özneyi birleştirip "bunlar aynı/benzer/farklı" → **the same / similar / different** (tek başına, sona).

### like = similar to / alike = similar
- My car is **similar to** your car = My car is **like** your car.
- My car and yours **are similar** = My car and yours **are alike**.
- **like** → nesne alır (like your car). **alike** → tek başına sona gelir (are alike).

**Not:** similar sıfat olarak da kullanılır: You must have **similar** backgrounds.

**Dikkat:**
- doğru edatlar: same **as**, similar **to**, different **from** (karıştırma!)
- like (nesneli) vs alike (tek başına) — tıpkı similar to / similar gibi.

topics.title: Comparatives (-er than / more ... than)
topics.notes:
İki şeyi kıyaslarken "daha ..." demek için.

| Sıfat | Kural | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Tek heceli | sıfat + **-er than** | Mary is **older than** John. |
| Çok heceli (2+) | **more** + sıfat + **than** | She is **more intelligent than** her brother. |

- Tek hece: old→older, small→smaller, tall→taller, cheap→cheaper
- Çok hece: important→more important, beautiful→more beautiful, expensive→more expensive
- Health is **more important than** money.

### Düzensiz karşılaştırmalar (ezberle)
| Sıfat | Comparative |
|---|---|
| good | **better** |
| bad | **worse** |
| far | **farther / further** |

- My grades are **better than** my brother's.
- Her situation is **worse than** before.
- My school is **farther than** yours.

**Dikkat:**
- Tek hecede "more" KULLANMA: more old ❌ → older ✅
- Çok hecede "-er" KULLANMA: intelligenter ❌ → more intelligent ✅
- "than" unutma: older **than**, more important **than**.

topics.title: as ... as / less ... than (Eşitlik ve Azlık)
topics.notes:
Kıyaslama merdiveni: **less / not as...as (az)** → **as...as (eşit)** →
**-er/more...than (daha)** → **the -est/the most (en)**.
Bu konu merdivenin sol iki kutusudur.

### as + sıfat + as = EŞİTLİK ("... kadar")
İki şey aynı seviyede. **Sıfat daima YALIN** (kısa-uzun fark etmez).

| Yapı | Örnek | Anlam |
|---|---|---|
| as + sıfat + as | Mark is **as tall as** Jason. | Mark, Jason **kadar** uzun. |
| as + sıfat + as | My car is **as fast as** an airplane. | Arabam uçak **kadar** hızlı. |

⚠️ as **tall** as ✅ / as ~~taller~~ as ❌ / as ~~more tall~~ as ❌

### not as + sıfat + as = EŞİT DEĞİL (= daha az)
- This house is **not as big as** a hotel. (Ev, otel kadar büyük değil = daha küçük.)

### less + sıfat + than = AZLIK ("daha az")
| Yapı | Örnek | Anlam |
|---|---|---|
| less + sıfat + than | This car is **less expensive than** a Ferrari. | Bu araba Ferrari'den **daha ucuz**. |

⚠️ **Tek heceli sıfatta "less" KULLANMA** → onun yerine **not as ... as**:
- less big ❌ → **not as big as** ✅
- less tall ❌ → **not as tall as** ✅
- Çok heceli sıfatta less serbest: less **expensive**, less **important** ✅

topics.title: but (Karşıtlık ve Yardımcı Fiil Yankısı)
topics.notes:
`but` = ama. İkinci cümlede **fiili tekrar etmeyiz**, sadece **yardımcı fiili**
bırakırız. Yankı, **birinci cümlenin zamanına/fiiline** göre seçilir
("What + do" ve kısa cevap mantığının aynısı).

| Birinci cümle | Yankı (but'tan sonra) | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Geniş – normal fiil | do / does (+n't) | He goes to school every day **but I don't**. |
| to be | is / are / am (+not) | Istanbul is a big city **but Yalova isn't**. |
| can | can / can't | We can swim **but they can't**. |
| be able to | are/were able to | Birds are able to fly **but humans aren't**. |
| will | will / won't | They will sing a song **but we won't**. |
| Past – normal fiil | did / didn't | They didn't go there **but we did**. |
| Past – to be | was / were (+n't) | They weren't poor **but we were**. |

- Balls are round **but books aren't**.
- Mary isn't poor **but Jane is**.

**Mantık:** birinci cümlede hangi yardımcı varsa (veya olması gereken do/does/did),
onu yankılarsın. Olumlu ↔ olumsuz genelde ters döner (big but ... isn't).

topics.title: Superlatives (En üstünlük) + one of the
topics.notes:
Bir grubun **EN**'ini söyler. Comparative'in (konu 20) tavan hâli; kural yine
hece sayısına bağlı.

| Sıfat türü | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Tek heceli | **the** + sıfat + **-est** | Kate is **the oldest** person in this room. |
| Tek heceli | the + -est | The Nile is **the longest** river in the world. |
| Çok heceli (2+) | **the most** + sıfat | Istanbul is **the most crowded** city in Turkey. |
| Çok heceli | the most + sıfat | Health is **the most important** thing in life. |

### Düzensizler (ezber — comparative'in aynısı)
| Sıfat | Comparative | Superlative |
|---|---|---|
| good | better | **the best** |
| bad | worse | **the worst** |
| far | farther/further | **the farthest / furthest** |

- Steve got **the best** grade in the exam.
- She is **the worst** student at this school.
- This is **the farthest** place in this city.

⚠️ Neredeyse her zaman yanında:
- **the** unutma: ~~oldest person~~ → **the** oldest person
- genelde **in + grup/yer**: the tallest **in the class**, the longest **in the world**

### one of the + superlative ("...lardan biri")
| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| one of the + superlative + **çoğul isim** | He is **one of the tallest boys** in the class. |

⚠️ **Konu 14 ile bağ:** `one of the` → isim **ÇOĞUL** (boys) ama özne tekil
olduğu için **fiil TEKİL**: One of the **boys is** very tall. (are ❌)

topics.title: Zarflar (Adverbs) + Zarflarla Karşılaştırma
topics.notes:
Sıfat **ismi** niteler, zarf **fiili** niteler. Zarfla karşılaştırma ayrı bir
konu değildir — kıyaslama merdiveninin (konu 20–23) fiile uygulanmış hâlidir.

### Sıfat mı, zarf mı?
| Sıfat (isimle) | Zarf (fiille) |
|---|---|
| Jason is a **careful** driver. | Jason drives **carefully**. |
| They are **quick** learners. | They learn **quickly**. |
| She is a **good** speaker. | She speaks **well**. |

### Zarf yapımı
- Çoğu: sıfat + **-ly** → slow/slowly, careful/carefully, quick/quickly, clear/clearly, beautiful/beautifully
- Düzensiz: **good → well** (en önemli istisna)
- Değişmeyenler (sıfat = zarf, **-ly almaz**): **fast, hard, early, late, much, little**
  - He works **hard**. / She came **early**. / He drives **fast**.

⚠️ **hard** (sıkı/zor) ≠ **hardly** (neredeyse hiç) — farklı kelimeler.

### Zarflarla karşılaştırma (form kararı verir)
| Zarf tipi | Comparative | Superlative | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| **-ly** (çok heceli gibi) | **more** + zarf | **the most** + zarf | quietly → more quietly → the most quietly |
| **Kısa / değişmeyen** | zarf + **-er** | the + zarf + **-est** | hard → harder → the hardest; fast → faster → fastest; early → earlier → earliest |

Düzensizler (sıfatlarla birebir aynı):

| Zarf | Comparative | Superlative |
|---|---|---|
| well | **better** | **best** |
| badly | **worse** | **worst** |
| far | **farther/further** | **farthest/furthest** |
| little | **less** | **least** |
| much | **more** | **most** |

- Chris speaks **more fluently than** Mary does.
- Jim works **harder than** his brother.
- The girl ran **farther than** her friends.
- Everyone runs fast, but Mike runs **the fastest** of all.
- Jason speaks **the most carefully** of them.

⚠️ Superlative zarfta da **the**: runs **the** fastest, speaks **the** most carefully.
⚠️ "the best of **the any** player" ❌ → **the best of all (the players)** / **better than any other player**.

### as + zarf + as (eşitlik)
- I work **as hard as** you do.
- He runs **as fast as** a horse.
- They speak English **as fluently as** native speakers.

topics.title: should (Tavsiye: -meli / -malı)
topics.notes:
Tavsiye/öneri verir. Modal'dır → sonrasında fiil **yalın (V1)**: -s, -to, -ing almaz
(bkz. konu 10). must/have to kadar güçlü değildir.

| Biçim | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | özne + **should** + V1 | You **should stop** smoking. |
| Olumsuz | **shouldn't** + V1 | You **shouldn't drive** fast. |
| Soru | **Should** + özne + V1? | Should I tell the truth? / Where should we park? |
| never | should **never** + V1 | We **should never break** the rules. |

⚠️ should drives ❌ / should to go ❌ → **should drive / should go** (V1).
**Kalıp:** as soon as possible = mümkün olan en kısa sürede.

topics.title: Öneri Yapıları (Let's / Why don't)
topics.notes:
İkisi de öneri ("haydi") ama yapıları farklı:

| Kalıp | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Let's** | Let's + **fiil** (özne YOK) | Let's **go** to the cinema. |
| **Let's not** (olumsuz) | Let's not + fiil | Let's **not do** it now. |
| **Why don't** | Why don't + **özne** + fiil | Why don't **we go** to the cinema? |

- Let's = Let us (konuşan dahil, "biz").
- ⚠️ **Fark:** Let's'ten sonra doğrudan **fiil**; Why don't'tan sonra **özne + fiil** gelir.
  - Why don't **you** start learning English? (özne şart)

topics.title: have to / must (Zorunluluk) + Prohibition
topics.notes:
### have to — zorunluluk (genelde dış kural/durum)
| Özne | Yapı |
|---|---|
| I / you / we / they | **have to** + V1 |
| he / she / it | **has to** + V1 |

- Jane **has to** wear a uniform. (Jane have to ❌)
- Olumsuz: **don't / doesn't have to** = "gerek yok, yapmasan da olur":
  You **don't have to** wear a coat.
- Soru: **Do / Does** + özne + **have to**...? → Yes, I do. / No, he doesn't.

### must — güçlü zorunluluk (genelde içsel/konuşanın kararı + yazılı kurallar)
- Yapı: **özne + must + V1** (tüm öznelerde aynı, **-s yok**): He **must study**.
- must ≈ içsel/güçlü; have to ≈ dıştan (kural, durum). Olumluda çoğu zaman aynı.

### ⚠️ Olumsuzda anlam TERS döner (en kritik nokta)
| Olumsuz | Anlam |
|---|---|
| **mustn't** + V1 | YASAK — sakın yapma: You **mustn't** smoke here. |
| **don't have to** + V1 | gerek yok — istersen yapma: You **don't have to** come. |

### Prohibition (yasak) = must not / mustn't
- You **mustn't play** with matches.
- ⚠️ mustn't zaten olumsuz → "mustn't **not** play" ❌ → **mustn't play**.

### must ile soru (az kullanılır)
- Yapı: **Must + özne + V1?** → Must you go now? / What must I do now?
- Günlük dilde soru çoğunlukla have to ile sorulur: **Do** you **have to** go now?

topics.title: Past Continuous (Geçmişte Süreklilik) + when / while
topics.notes:
Geçmişte **belirli bir anda sürmekte olan** eylem ("yapıyordu").

### Yapı: was/were + fiil-ing
| Özne | Yardımcı |
|---|---|
| I / he / she / it | **was** + fiil-ing |
| you / we / they | **were** + fiil-ing |

- I **was reading** a book at 9 o'clock last night.
- They **were studying** English this time last week. *(this time last week = geçen hafta bu saatlerde; at that moment = o anda)*
- Olumsuz: **wasn't / weren't** + ing → I **wasn't** sleeping.
- Soru: **Was/Were** + özne + ing? → **Were** you sleeping when I called?

### when vs while (iki eylem)
| Bağlaç | Sonrasında | Hangi eylem |
|---|---|---|
| **when** | **Past Simple** | kısa / ani olay (came, happened) |
| **while** | **Past Continuous** | süren eylem (were having) |

- I **was eating** dinner **when** my father **came** home. *(süren + ani)*
- We **were sitting** in the living room **when** the earthquake **happened**.
- It **began** to rain **while** we **were having** a picnic.
- İki eylem de sürüyorsa → iki taraf Past Continuous:
  **While** I **was reading**, my sister **was listening** to music.

⚠️ Hafıza: **when → kısa olay (Past Simple); while → süren eylem (was/were + ing).**
⚠️ Cümle başa gelirse **virgül**: When he came home, I was eating.

topics.title: used to (Eskiden ...ardım)
topics.notes:
Eskiden yapılan ama **artık yapılmayan** alışkanlık / durum.

| Biçim | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | özne + **used to** + V1 | I **used to smoke**. (Eskiden sigara içerdim.) |
| Olumsuz | özne + **didn't use to** + V1 | I **didn't use to like** chocolate. |
| Soru | **Did** + özne + **use to** + V1? | **Did** you **use to** have long hair? |

- She **used to play** the guitar very well, but then she stopped.
- Where **did** you **use to** live? / What **did** you **use to** play when you **were** a child?
- **never used to** de olur: I **never used to** cook.

⚠️ **did varsa "d" düşer:** didn't **use** to / Did you **use** to (used to ❌). Olumluda **used** to.
⚠️ "last year" gibi tek bir zamanla used to garip durur; used to "eskiden, uzun süre" demektir: I used to smoke **when I was young**.
⚠️ Sonrasında fiil daima **yalın**: used to **play** (played / playing ❌).

topics.title: Present Perfect (have / has + V3)
topics.notes:
Geçmişte olmuş ama **etkisi / bağlantısı şimdi** süren eylem. Ne zaman olduğu söylenmez.

| Özne | Yapı |
|---|---|
| I / you / we / they | **have** + V3 |
| he / she / it | **has** + V3 |

- We **have had** our dinner. We aren't hungry now.
- He **has had** a car accident. He is in the hospital now.
- Olumsuz: **haven't / hasn't** + V3. Soru: **Have / Has** + özne + V3?

### just / already / yet
| Kelime | Anlam | Yer | Örnek |
|---|---|---|---|
| **just** | az önce | have ile V3 arası | I have **just** painted the room. |
| **already** | çoktan | have ile V3 arası | I have **already** done my homework. |
| **yet** | henüz (olumsuz) / hiç (soru) | cümle **sonu** | I haven't finished the project **yet**. / Have you finished **yet**? |

### ever / never / kaç kez (deneyim)
- **Have you ever** played soccer? → Yes, I **have played** it **many times**. / No, I **have never played** it.
- I have eaten sushi **once / twice / three times / several times**.
- I **haven't been** to Paris **before**.
- ⚠️ never zaten olumsuz → **have never** (haven't never ❌).

### for / since / How long
| | Ne anlatır | Örnekler |
|---|---|---|
| **for** | SÜRE | for five minutes, ten days, two years, **ages** |
| **since** | başlangıç NOKTASI | since 1988, **last month**, two o'clock, Monday, **yesterday** |

- I **have lived** in Istanbul **for** two years. / **since** 2014.
- She **has watched** TV **for** two hours. / **since** 4 o'clock.
- **How long** have you lived here? → For two months. / Since April.
- How long **has** she **been** in this city? → She **has been** here for ten years. (she is been ❌)

### ⚠️ Present Perfect mi, Past Simple mi?
- Zaman belli (yesterday, last year, in 2020, ago) → **Past Simple**: I **saw** him yesterday.
- Zaman belli değil / hâlâ süren → **Present Perfect**: I **have seen** that film. / I have lived here for 2 years.
- I have seen him yesterday ❌

### Düzensiz fiiller (V1 – V2 – V3)
| V1 | V2 | V3 | Türkçe |
|---|---|---|---|
| be | was / were | been | olmak |
| have | had | had | sahip olmak |
| do | did | done | yapmak |
| go | went | gone | gitmek |
| come | came | come | gelmek |
| eat | ate | eaten | yemek |
| drink | drank | drunk | içmek |
| see | saw | seen | görmek |
| break | broke | broken | kırmak |
| sleep | slept | slept | uyumak |
| swim | swam | swum | yüzmek |
| write | wrote | written | yazmak |
| take | took | taken | almak |
| give | gave | given | vermek |
| fall | fell | fallen | düşmek |
| make | made | made | yapmak |
| buy | bought | bought | satın almak |
| work | worked | worked | çalışmak (düzenli: -ed) |

topics.title: Past Perfect (had + V3)
topics.notes:
Geçmişteki iki olaydan **daha önce olanı** anlatır ("-mıştı").
Yapı **tüm öznelerde aynı**: **had + V3**

| Biçim | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | had + V3 | The train **had left** when I arrived. |
| Olumsuz | hadn't + V3 | I **hadn't seen** the film before. |
| Soru | Had + özne + V3? | **Had** you **eaten** before you came? |

- Kısaltma: I'd left (= I had left). ⚠️ I'd + V3 = had, I'd + V1 = would (I'd go).

### Zaman çizgisi mantığı
**1. olay (daha eski) → Past Perfect**, **2. olay → Past Simple**
- When I **arrived** at the station, the train **had** already **left**. (Önce tren gitti, sonra ben vardım.)
- She **had finished** her homework **before** she **watched** TV.
- **By the time** we **got** there, the film **had started**. (biz vardığımızda ... çoktan başlamıştı)

### Past Simple mı, Past Perfect mi?
| Cümle | Anlam |
|---|---|
| When I arrived, the train **left**. | Ben vardığım anda tren kalktı (aynı an / ardışık). |
| When I arrived, the train **had left**. | Ben vardığımda tren çoktan gitmişti. |

⚠️ **before / after** zaten sırayı gösterdiği için günlük dilde iki taraf Past Simple da olabilir:
After she **finished** / **had finished** her homework, she watched TV. (ikisi de doğru)
⚠️ Tek bir geçmiş olayda Past Perfect kullanılmaz: I **had gone** to Paris last year ❌ → I **went** ✅
⚠️ Sık kullanılanlar: already, just, never, before, by the time, when.

topics.title: Koşul Cümleleri 2 (Third Conditional + unless)
topics.notes:
> Not: Kurstaki "Koşul Cümleleri 2" dersinin içeriği third conditional varsayılarak yazıldı.
> Dersi izledikten sonra farklı bir şey işlendiyse bu bölüm güncellenecek.

### Third Conditional – geçmişte olmamış, hayali
Yapı: **If + had + V3, would have + V3**
Anlam: "...seydi, ...rdı" — geçmişte olmadı, artık değiştirilemez (pişmanlık / hayal).

- If I **had studied**, I **would have passed** the exam. (Çalışsaydım geçerdim — çalışmadım, kaldım.)
- If she **had left** earlier, she **wouldn't have missed** the bus.
- **Would** you **have come** if I **had invited** you?

### Dört tip yan yana
| Tip | if tarafı | sonuç tarafı | Anlam |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zero | present | present | genel doğru |
| First | present | will + V1 | gerçek, olası gelecek |
| Second | past (were) | would + V1 | şimdi/gelecek için hayali |
| **Third** | **had + V3** | **would have + V3** | **geçmiş için hayali** |

⚠️ if tarafında **would olmaz**: If I would have studied ❌ → If I **had studied** ✅
⚠️ Kısaltma: I'd have passed = I would have passed. "If I'd known" = If I **had** known.

### unless = if ... not
- **Unless** you study, you will fail. = **If** you **don't** study, you will fail.
- ⚠️ unless zaten olumsuz: Unless you **don't** study ❌ → Unless you **study** ✅
- unless'ten sonra da **will yok** (if kuralının aynısı).

topics.title: Tag Questions (Onay Soruları)
topics.notes:
Cümlenin sonuna eklenen "değil mi?" sorusu. Mantık konu 22'deki **yardımcı fiil yankısının** aynısı:
**olumlu cümle → olumsuz tag, olumsuz cümle → olumlu tag.** Tag'de özne daima **zamir** olur.

| Cümle | Tag |
|---|---|
| You **are** a student, | **aren't you**? |
| She **isn't** tired, | **is she**? |
| He **works** here, | **doesn't he**? |
| They **didn't** come, | **did they**? |
| You **can** swim, | **can't you**? |
| It **will** rain, | **won't it**? |
| She **has** finished, | **hasn't she**? |
| Mike **was** at home, | **wasn't he**? |

### Özel durumlar ⚠️
| Cümle | Tag | Not |
|---|---|---|
| I **am** right, | **aren't I**? | amn't I ❌ |
| **Let's** go, | **shall we**? | öneri |
| **Open** the door, | **will you**? | emir cümlesi |
| There **is** a problem, | **isn't there**? | there tekrar edilir |
| He **never** lies, | **does he**? | never/nothing/nobody zaten olumsuz → olumlu tag |
| **Everyone** is here, | **aren't they**? | everyone/someone → they |
| **This** is yours, | **isn't it**? | this/that → it |

### Tonlama
- Ses **düşerse** (↘): emin, onay bekliyor. It's cold today, isn't it? ↘
- Ses **yükselirse** (↗): gerçekten soruyor, emin değil.

### Cevap
Cevap gerçeğe göre verilir: She isn't tired, is she? → **No, she isn't.** (yorgun değil) / **Yes, she is.** (aslında yorgun)

topics.title: Boş Zaman (Free Time)
topics.notes:
| Kalıp | Anlam |
|---|---|
| What do you like to do in your **free time**? | Boş zamanında ne yaparsın? |
| I'm **keen on** + fiil-ing | ...e meraklıyım / bayılırım |
| Is this your **day off**? | Bugün izin günün mü? |
| What do you **enjoy** doing? | Ne yapmaktan hoşlanırsın? |
| **well** | şey, ee (düşünürken dolgu kelimesi) |

⚠️ **En önemli kural — fiil biçimi:**
- **keen on / enjoy** → sonrasında fiil **-ing**: keen on **going**, enjoy **cooking**
- **like / would like** → sonrasında **to + yalın fiil**: like **to go**, would like **to watch**
- keen on go ❌ / keen on to go ❌ → keen on **going** ✅
- I would like **to go to the** pub. (to got ❌)

topics.title: Çocukluk Dönemi (Childhood)
topics.notes:
| Kalıp | Anlam |
|---|---|
| Did you have a happy **childhood**? | Mutlu bir çocukluğun oldu mu? |
| What did you want to **be** when you were a **child**? | Çocukken ne olmak istedin? |
| I **dreamed of being** a pilot | Pilot olmayı hayal ederdim |
| **hide and seek** | saklambaç |
| **skipping rope** | ip atlama |
| **peers** | yaşıtlar, akranlar |

⚠️ **Fiil biçimi:**
- **dream of** → sonrasında **-ing**: dreamed **of being** (of be ❌, of to be ❌)
- Geçmiş soru: What **did** you **want**...? (did varsa fiil yalın: want)
- Cevaplar geçmiş: I **dreamed** / **enjoyed** / **liked**...

**Yazım:** childhood (chieldhold ❌), child (chield ❌), fashion designer, really.

topics.title: Evcil Hayvanlar (Pets) + Present Perfect / since-for
topics.notes:
### How long have you had him? → Present Perfect (have/has + V3)
Geçmişte başlayıp **hâlâ süren** durum.
- I **have had** him **since** he was a puppy. / I've had him **for** three years.
- **since** = -den beri (başlangıç NOKTASI): since 2020, since Monday, since he was a puppy.
- **for** = ... boyunca (SÜRE): for three years, for a long time.

### won't (= will not) → isteksizlik / "izin vermez, yapmaz"
- My mom **won't let me** have a pet. (Annem izin vermez.)
- He **won't bite** you. (Seni ısırmaz.)
- **let + kişi + yalın fiil** = birine izin vermek: let **me go**, let **him stay**.

### as long as = ...dığı sürece (koşul → sonrasında Present, will YOK)
- I'll stroke him **as long as he doesn't bite me**. (as long as he won't bite ❌)
- Tıpkı if / when / before / after gibi: koşul/zaman bağlacından sonra present.

### What a + (sıfat) + isim! = Ne kadar ... bir ...! (ünlem)
- **What a sweet dog!** / What a lovely cat!

### Would you like to...? = ...mak ister misin? (kibar davet)
- Would you like **to come**? → Yes, that would be great.

### Diğer kalıplar
- Did you **feed** the cat? → I'll do that **in a minute**. (birazdan)
- You shouldn't **make him wait**. (onu bekletmemelisin — make + kişi + yalın fiil)
- He **likes meeting** new people. / Your dog is **well trained**.

### Kelimeler
| İngilizce | Türkçe |
|---|---|
| unfortunately | maalesef |
| pet / puppy | evcil hayvan / yavru köpek |
| fur | tüy, kürk |
| stroke (a dog) | okşamak, sevmek |
| bite (bit, bitten) | ısırmak |
| trained / trainer | eğitimli / eğitmen |
| member of the family | aileden biri |
| pet shop | evcil hayvan dükkanı |
| all the time | sürekli, her zaman |

⚠️ any pets (eny ❌); go **to the** pet shop (go the ❌); would you like **to** come.

topics.title: to be (am / is / are)
topics.notes:
| Özne | Olumlu | Olumsuz | Soru |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | I **am** | I**'m not** | **Am** I...? |
| he / she / it | she **is** | she **isn't** | **Is** she...? |
| you / we / they | they **are** | they **aren't** | **Are** they...? |

- Kısa cevap: Are you tired? → Yes, I **am**. / No, I**'m not**.
- ⚠️ Kısa olumlu cevapta kısaltma yok: Yes, I'm ❌ → Yes, I **am** ✅
- to be varsa do/does gelmez: Are you happy? ✅ / Do you happy? ❌

topics.title: this / that / these / those
topics.notes:
| | Yakın | Uzak |
|---|---|---|
| Tekil | **this** book | **that** book |
| Çoğul | **these** books | **those** books |

- This **is** my pen. / These **are** my pens.
- Telefonda kendini tanıtma: **This is** Ali. (Ben Ali.)
- ⚠️ these/those + çoğul isim + **are**: these book ❌ → these **books** ✅

topics.title: Düzensiz çoğullar
topics.notes:
| Tekil | Çoğul |
|---|---|
| man / woman | **men / women** |
| child | **children** |
| person | **people** |
| tooth / foot | **teeth / feet** |
| mouse | **mice** |
| fish / sheep | **fish / sheep** (değişmez) |

- ⚠️ people zaten çoğul: people **are** ✅ / peoples ❌ (halklar anlamı hariç)
- ⚠️ -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives, wife → wives, leaf → leaves

topics.title: can / can't
topics.notes:
- **can + yalın fiil** = -ebilir (yetenek, izin, rica)
- Tüm öznelerde aynı: He **can swim**. (cans ❌, can swims ❌)
- Olumsuz: **can't** (cannot). Soru: **Can** you drive? → Yes, I **can**. / No, I **can't**.
- İzin: **Can** I open the window?

topics.title: have got / has got
topics.notes:
| Özne | Olumlu | Olumsuz | Soru |
|---|---|---|---|
| I / you / we / they | have got ('ve got) | haven't got | **Have** you got...? |
| he / she / it | has got ('s got) | hasn't got | **Has** she got...? |

- Anlam = have (sahip olmak): I've got a car = I have a car.
- Kısa cevap: Have you got a pen? → Yes, I **have**. / No, I **haven't**.
- ⚠️ have got ile do kullanılmaz: Do you have got ❌. Ya **Do you have** ya **Have you got**.
- ⚠️ Geçmişte have got yok: I **had** a car.

topics.title: Sayılabilen / sayılamayan + some / any
topics.notes:
- Sayılabilen: a book, two **books** (tekil/çoğul olur)
- Sayılamayan: water, money, rice, bread, milk, advice, information (çoğul -s almaz, a/an almaz)

| | Olumlu | Olumsuz | Soru |
|---|---|---|---|
| Çoğul / sayılamayan | **some** | **any** | **any** |

- There is **some** milk. / There isn't **any** milk. / Is there **any** milk?
- ⚠️ Teklif ve ricada soruda da **some**: Would you like **some** tea? / Can I have **some** water?

topics.title: How much / How many
topics.notes:
- **How many** + çoğul sayılabilen: How many **books** have you got?
- **How much** + sayılamayan: How much **water** do you drink?
- Fiyat sormak: **How much is** this shirt? / **How much are** these shoes?
- ⚠️ How many money ❌ → How **much** money ✅

topics.title: Yer edatları
topics.notes:
| Edat | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| in | içinde | in the box, in the kitchen |
| on | üstünde (temas) | on the table, on the wall |
| under | altında | under the bed |
| next to | yanında | next to the bank |
| behind / in front of | arkasında / önünde | behind the door |
| between | arasında | between the bank and the cafe |
| opposite | karşısında | opposite the school |

- Şehir, ülke → **in**: in Ankara. Adres/nokta → **at**: at the bus stop, at home, at school.

topics.title: like / love / hate + -ing
topics.notes:
- Hoşlanma fiillerinden sonra fiil **-ing**: I **like reading**. She **loves cooking**. They **hate waiting**.
- don't like / don't mind (umursamam) + -ing: I **don't mind walking**.
- he/she → like**s**: He **likes swimming**. (He like ❌)
- ⚠️ **would like + to**: I'd like **to** go. (bkz. A1 konu 12)

topics.title: be going to (plan ve kanıta dayalı tahmin)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **am/is/are + going to + yalın fiil**
- Önceden yapılmış plan: I**'m going to visit** my aunt this weekend.
- Görünen bir işarete dayalı tahmin: Look at the clouds! It**'s going to rain**.
- Olumsuz: I'm **not** going to... Soru: **Are** you going to...?
- ⚠️ is going to **goes** ❌ → is going to **go** ✅

topics.title: Sayılar, tarih ve saat
topics.notes:
- Sıra sayıları: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, ... twelfth, twentieth, twenty-first
- Tarih: **on** 5 May → "the fifth of May" / "May fifth". Yıl: 2024 → "twenty twenty-four".
- Saat: 7:00 seven o'clock · 7:15 **quarter past** seven · 7:30 **half past** seven · 7:45 **quarter to** eight · 7:10 ten **past** seven · 7:50 ten **to** eight
- What time is it? → It's half past three.
- ⚠️ 13 thirteen ≠ 30 thirty (vurgu: thir**TEEN** / **THIR**ty)

topics.title: and / but / or / because / so
topics.notes:
| Bağlaç | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| and | ve | I like tea **and** coffee. |
| but | ama | It's cheap **but** good. |
| or | veya | Tea **or** coffee? |
| because | çünkü (sebep) | I stayed home **because** I was ill. |
| so | bu yüzden (sonuç) | I was ill, **so** I stayed home. |

- ⚠️ because sebebin önüne, so sonucun önüne gelir.

topics.title: Sıfatların yeri
topics.notes:
- Sıfat **isimden önce** gelir: a **big** house (a house big ❌)
- ya da **be fiilinden sonra**: The house **is big**.
- Sıfat çoğul almaz: two **big** houses (bigs ❌)
- a/an sıfata göre seçilir: **an** old car, **a** new car

topics.title: Wh- soruları (to be ile)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **Soru kelimesi + am/is/are + özne?**
- Where **is** the station? / How old **are** you? / What **is** your name? / Who **is** that man?
- How **are** you? → I'm fine. / What's the weather like? → It's sunny.
- ⚠️ to be sorusunda do yok: Where **is** she? (Where does she is ❌)

topics.title: will vs be going to
topics.notes:
| | will | be going to |
|---|---|---|
| Karar | **o anda** verilen karar: The phone is ringing. I**'ll** answer it. | **önceden** verilmiş plan: I**'m going to** buy a car next month. |
| Tahmin | görüşe dayalı: I think she**'ll** win. | göz önündeki kanıta dayalı: Look! He**'s going to** fall. |
| Diğer | söz, teklif, rica: I'll help you. / Will you open the door? | |

- Kesin randevu/ayarlama: Present Continuous: I**'m meeting** Ali at 5.

topics.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
topics.notes:
| Present Simple | Present Continuous |
|---|---|
| alışkanlık, rutin, genel doğru | şu an olan, geçici durum |
| I **work** in a bank. | I**'m working** from home this week. |
| every day, usually, often | now, at the moment, today, this week |

- Durum fiilleri (know, want, like, need...) continuous olmaz: I **know** ✅ / I'm knowing ❌
- Soru: What **do** you do? (meslek) / What **are** you doing? (şu an)

topics.title: much / many / a lot of / a few / a little
topics.notes:
| | Sayılabilen (çoğul) | Sayılamayan |
|---|---|---|
| çok | many / a lot of | much / a lot of |
| biraz | a few | a little |

- much / many genelde **olumsuz ve soruda**: I don't have **much** time. / Are there **many** people?
- Olumluda **a lot of** daha doğal: I have **a lot of** friends.
- a few **books** / a little **money**

topics.title: Fiil + -ing / fiil + to
topics.notes:
- **+ -ing**: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, stop, like, love, hate, keen on, good at (edattan sonra daima -ing)
- **+ to**: want, need, decide, hope, plan, learn, would like, try, forget, promise
- I **enjoy swimming**. / I **want to swim**. / I **decided to stay**.
- ⚠️ Edattan sonra fiil -ing: interested **in learning**, good **at cooking**

topics.title: Edilgen yapı (Present / Past Simple)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **am/is/are + V3** (geniş), **was/were + V3** (geçmiş)
- English **is spoken** here. / This bridge **was built** in 1973.
- Yapan önemliyse **by**: The book **was written by** Orhan Pamuk.
- Olumsuz: isn't / wasn't + V3. Soru: **Is** it made...? / **Was** it built...?
- ⚠️ V3 şart: was build ❌ → was **built** ✅

topics.title: who / which / that (relative clause)
topics.notes:
- **who** → insan: The man **who** lives next door is a doctor.
- **which** → nesne, hayvan: The car **which** I bought is red.
- **that** → ikisi için de: the man **that** / the car **that**
- **where** → yer: the city **where** I was born
- ⚠️ Özne tekrar edilmez: The man who **he** lives ❌ → The man who lives ✅

topics.title: a / the / article yok
topics.notes:
- Meslekte **a/an**: She's **a** doctor.
- Tekrar edilen, bilinen → **the**: I saw a film. **The** film was great.
- Genel anlam, çoğul/sayılamayan → article yok: **Dogs** are friendly. **Money** isn't everything.
- Article yok: go to **school / work / bed**, at **home**, by **bus**, öğünler (have **breakfast**), sporlar (play **football**)
- **the** + çalgılar (play **the** guitar), nehir/deniz (**the** Black Sea), tek olanlar (**the** sun)

topics.title: ago / during / until / by
topics.notes:
- **ago** = önce (geçmiş zamanla): two days **ago**, a long time **ago**
- **during** + isim = sırasında: **during** the film, **during** the summer
- **until** = -e kadar (süre devam eder): I'll wait **until** 6.
- **by** = en geç: Finish it **by** Friday. (Cumaya kadar bitir, Cuma en son)
- ⚠️ during + cümle olmaz → **while**: while I was eating

topics.title: Sık phrasal verb'ler
topics.notes:
| Fiil | Anlam |
|---|---|
| get up | kalkmak |
| wake up | uyanmak |
| look for | aramak |
| look after | bakmak (çocuk, hayvan) |
| turn on / off | açmak / kapatmak |
| put on / take off | giymek / çıkarmak |
| give up | vazgeçmek, bırakmak |
| find out | öğrenmek, bulmak |
| pick up | almak, kaldırmak |
| go out | dışarı çıkmak |
| come back | geri dönmek |

- Nesne zamir ise araya girer: turn **it** on ✅ / turn on it ❌

topics.title: Hareket edatları
topics.notes:
| Edat | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| into / out of | içine / dışına | She went **into** the room. |
| across | karşıdan karşıya | walk **across** the street |
| through | içinden geçerek | drive **through** the tunnel |
| along | boyunca | walk **along** the river |
| up / down | yukarı / aşağı | go **up** the stairs |
| over / under | üzerinden / altından | jump **over** the wall |
| past | önünden geçerek | walk **past** the bank |
| towards | -e doğru | run **towards** the door |

topics.title: So do I / Neither do I
topics.notes:
- Olumlu cümleye katılma: **So + yardımcı fiil + I**
  - I like tea. → **So do I.** / I'm tired. → **So am I.** / I can swim. → **So can I.**
- Olumsuz cümleye katılma: **Neither + yardımcı fiil + I**
  - I don't like tea. → **Neither do I.** / I wasn't there. → **Neither was I.**
- Gündelik: Me too. (olumlu) / Me neither. (olumsuz)
- Yardımcı fiil, but yankısındaki (A2 konu 22) mantıkla seçilir.

topics.title: Present Simple vs Continuous (tekrar) + geçici/değişen durumlar
topics.notes:
- Geçici durum: I**'m living** with my parents **at the moment** (kalıcı değil).
- Değişen/gelişen durum: It**'s getting** colder. / Prices **are going up**.
- **always + Continuous** = şikâyet: He**'s always losing** his keys!
- Kalıcı durum ve rutin: I **live** in Ankara. / I **get up** at 7.

topics.title: Gelecek biçimleri: will / going to / Present Continuous / Present Simple (tarife)
topics.notes:
| Biçim | Ne zaman | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Present Continuous | kesin ayarlama, randevu | I**'m meeting** Ali tomorrow. |
| be going to | niyet, plan; kanıta dayalı tahmin | I**'m going to** learn German. |
| will | anlık karar, söz, görüş | I**'ll** call you later. |
| Present Simple | tarife, program | The train **leaves** at 6. |

topics.title: Present Perfect Continuous
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **have/has been + -ing**
- Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren (süre vurgusu): I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.
- Yeni bitmiş, izi görünen: You're wet. **Have** you **been running**?
- **How long have you been** learning English? → For two years. / Since 2024.

topics.title: Present Perfect Simple vs Continuous
topics.notes:
- Simple → sonuç / miktar: I**'ve read** three books this month.
- Continuous → süreç / süre: I**'ve been reading** all day.
- Durum fiilleri continuous olmaz: I**'ve known** him for years. (I've been knowing ❌)

topics.title: Past Simple vs Present Perfect (tekrar)
topics.notes: **Yapı / örnek:** I saw him yesterday. / I've seen him.

topics.title: Anlatı zamanları: Past Simple + Continuous + Perfect bir arada
topics.notes:
- Arka plan → Past Continuous: It **was raining**...
- Ana olaylar → Past Simple: ...when I **arrived**.
- Daha önce olan → Past Perfect: Everyone **had left**.
- When I **arrived**, it **was raining** and everyone **had** already **left**.

topics.title: used to vs would (geçmiş alışkanlık)
topics.notes:
- **used to** → geçmiş alışkanlık + geçmiş durum: I **used to have** long hair.
- **would** → sadece geçmişte tekrarlanan eylem: Every summer we **would go** to the village.
- ⚠️ Durum fiilinde would olmaz: I would have long hair ❌ → I **used to** have long hair ✅

topics.title: be used to / get used to (+ -ing) (B1+)
topics.notes:
- **be used to + -ing / isim** = alışkın olmak: I**'m used to getting** up early.
- **get used to + -ing** = alışmak (süreç): I**'m getting used to living** alone.
- ⚠️ used to + V1 (eskiden yapardım) ile karıştırma: I used to **work** ≠ I'm used to **working**.

topics.title: Future Continuous (B1+)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **will be + -ing** → gelecekte belli bir anda sürüyor olacak
- This time tomorrow I**'ll be flying** to London.
- At 8 pm I**'ll be watching** the match, so don't call.

topics.title: Past Perfect Continuous (B1+)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **had been + -ing** → geçmişteki bir andan önce bir süredir devam eden
- I **had been working** for five hours when he called.
- She was tired because she **had been running**.

topics.title: Çıkarım (şimdi): must / might / can't
topics.notes:
- **must** = eminim öyle (%95): He's been working all day. He **must be** tired.
- **might / may / could** = olabilir (%50): She **might be** at home.
- **can't** = eminim öyle değil: That **can't be** Ali. He's in London.
- ⚠️ Bu anlamda mustn't kullanılmaz: It mustn't be true ❌ → It **can't** be true ✅

topics.title: Geçmiş modal: should have / could have / might have + V3
topics.notes:
- **should have + V3** = yapmalıydın (yapmadın, pişmanlık): You **should have told** me.
- **shouldn't have + V3**: I **shouldn't have eaten** so much.
- **could have + V3** = yapabilirdin (ama yapmadın): You **could have called** me.
- **might / must / can't have + V3** = geçmiş hakkında çıkarım: He **must have forgotten**. / She **can't have seen** us.

topics.title: had better / ought to
topics.notes:
- **had better (’d better) + V1** = yapsan iyi olur (yoksa kötü sonuç): You**'d better hurry** or you'll miss the bus.
- Olumsuz: You**'d better not** be late.
- **ought to + V1** = should ile aynı (tavsiye): You **ought to** see a doctor.
- ⚠️ had better to ❌ / had better going ❌ → had better **go** ✅

topics.title: Gereklilik ve izin: need to / needn't / be allowed to
topics.notes:
- **need to** = gerekmek: I **need to** buy milk. Olumsuz: **don't need to** / **needn't** = gerek yok.
- **be allowed to** = izinli olmak: We**'re not allowed to** park here. / **Were** you **allowed to** go out?
- can (izin) ile benzer ama geçmiş ve gelecekte daha çok be allowed to kullanılır.

topics.title: First vs Second Conditional (karşılaştırma)
topics.notes: **Yapı / örnek:** If I win… / If I won…

topics.title: Third Conditional
topics.notes: **Yapı / örnek:** If I had studied, I would have passed.

topics.title: unless / as long as / in case
topics.notes:
- **unless** = if ... not: **Unless** you hurry, you'll be late.
- **as long as** = ...dığı sürece: You can borrow it **as long as** you bring it back.
- **in case** = ...ihtimaline karşı: Take an umbrella **in case** it rains.
- ⚠️ Hepsinden sonra **will yok**: in case it **rains** (it will rain ❌)

topics.title: wish / if only (B1+)
topics.notes:
- Şimdiki duruma dilek → **wish + Past Simple**: I **wish** I **had** more time. / I wish I **were** taller.
- Geçmişe pişmanlık → **wish + Past Perfect**: I **wish** I **had studied** harder.
- Başkasının davranışından şikâyet → **wish + would**: I wish you **would** stop talking.
- if only = wish'in daha güçlü hâli.

topics.title: Passive – Present / Past Simple
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **be + V3**: Cars **are made** in this factory. / The house **was built** in 1920.
- Yapanı söylemek gerekirse **by**: It was painted **by** Picasso.
- Ne zaman: yapan bilinmiyor, önemsiz ya da belli: My bike **was stolen**.

topics.title: Passive – diğer zamanlar (Present Perfect, will, modal)
topics.notes:
| Zaman | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Present Continuous | am/is/are being + V3 | The road **is being repaired**. |
| Present Perfect | have/has been + V3 | The car **has been sold**. |
| Past Perfect | had been + V3 | The tickets **had been sold**. |
| will | will be + V3 | It **will be finished** tomorrow. |
| Modal | modal + be + V3 | It **must be done** today. / It **can be seen**. |

topics.title: have something done (B1+)
topics.notes:
- Yapı: **have + nesne + V3** → işi başkasına yaptırmak
- I **had my hair cut**. (Saçımı kestirdim.) / We**'re having** the house **painted**.
- get something done = daha gündelik: I need to **get** my car **fixed**.

topics.title: Reported statements + zaman kaydırma, say vs tell
topics.notes:
| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| am/is → was | "I'm tired." → He said (that) he **was** tired. |
| Present Simple → Past Simple | "I live here." → She said she **lived** there. |
| Past Simple / Present Perfect → Past Perfect | "I saw it." → He said he **had seen** it. |
| will → would, can → could | "I'll help." → She said she **would** help. |

- **say** nesnesiz: He said that... / **tell** + kişi: He **told me** that...
- Yer/zaman da kayar: here → there, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day

topics.title: Reported questions
topics.notes:
- Evet/hayır sorusu → **if / whether**: "Are you OK?" → She asked **if I was** OK.
- Wh- sorusu → soru kelimesi + **düz cümle sırası**: "Where do you live?" → He asked where **I lived**.
- ⚠️ do/does/did kalkar, soru sırası olmaz: He asked where did I live ❌

topics.title: Reported commands / requests
topics.notes:
- tell / ask + kişi + **to + V1**: "Wait!" → He **told me to wait**.
- Olumsuz: **not to**: "Don't go." → She **asked me not to go**.

topics.title: Defining relative clauses: who / which / that / where / whose
topics.notes:
| Zamir | Ne için | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| who / that | insan | The woman **who** called you is my aunt. |
| which / that | nesne, hayvan | The phone **which** I bought is broken. |
| where | yer | That's the café **where** we met. |
| whose | aitlik (-in) | The boy **whose** bike was stolen... |
| when | zaman | the day **when** I met her |

- Zamir nesne ise atılabilir: The phone (**that**) I bought...

topics.title: Non-defining relative clauses (B1+)
topics.notes:
- Ek bilgi verir, **virgül** arasında: My brother, **who** lives in Izmir, is a doctor.
- Burada **that kullanılmaz** ve zamir atılamaz.

topics.title: Indirect (kibar) sorular
topics.notes:
- **Can you tell me / Do you know / I wonder** + soru kelimesi + **düz cümle**
- Where is the station? → Can you tell me where **the station is**?
- What time does it open? → Do you know what time **it opens**?
- Evet/hayır sorusu → **if**: Do you know **if** the shop is open?

topics.title: Tag questions
topics.notes: **Yapı / örnek:** It's cold, isn't it?

topics.title: So do I / Neither do I
topics.notes:
- A2.G47 ile aynı kural; B1'de tüm zamanlarla kullanılır:
- I've been to Rome. → **So have I.** / I didn't see it. → **Neither did I.** / I'd love to go. → **So would I.**

topics.title: Gerund vs Infinitive (enjoy doing / decide to do)
topics.notes:
- **+ -ing**: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest, keep, consider, can't stand, look forward to
- **+ to**: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, refuse, promise, manage, afford, offer
- Özne olarak -ing: **Swimming** is good for you.
- Sıfattan sonra to: It's **easy to learn**.

topics.title: Anlam değiştiren fiiller: stop / remember / try / forget + -ing / to
topics.notes:
| Fiil | + -ing | + to |
|---|---|---|
| stop | eylemi bırakmak: I **stopped smoking**. | bir şey yapmak için durmak: I **stopped to smoke**. |
| remember | yapmış olmayı hatırlamak: I remember **locking** the door. | yapmayı unutmamak: Remember **to lock** the door. |
| forget | yaptığını unutmak: I'll never forget **meeting** her. | yapmayı unutmak: I forgot **to call** him. |
| try | denemek (sonuç görmek için): Try **turning** it off. | çabalamak: I tried **to open** it, but I couldn't. |

topics.title: Amaç: to / in order to / so that
topics.notes:
- Amaç fiil ise **to / in order to + V1**: I went out **to buy** bread.
- Farklı özne ya da modal gerekiyorsa **so that + cümle**: I saved money **so that** I **could** travel.
- Olumsuz amaç: **so that ... not** / **in order not to**: I left early **so that** I **wouldn't** be late.

topics.title: Fiil / sıfat + edat (interested in, good at, depend on, afraid of)
topics.notes:
- **Sıfat**: good **at**, interested **in**, afraid **of**, proud **of**, tired **of**, angry **with**, different **from**, famous **for**, responsible **for**
- **Fiil**: depend **on**, listen **to**, wait **for**, look **at**, agree **with**, belong **to**, worry **about**, apologize **for**
- Edattan sonra fiil **-ing**: I'm interested **in learning** Spanish.

topics.title: Miktar: few / a few / little / a little / plenty of
topics.notes:
- **a few** (sayılabilen) / **a little** (sayılamayan) = biraz, yeterli (olumlu): I have **a few** friends here.
- **few / little** = çok az, yetersiz (olumsuz anlam): I have **few** friends here. (Neredeyse hiç yok.)
- **plenty of** = bolca: We have **plenty of** time.

topics.title: both / either / neither
topics.notes:
- **both (of)** = ikisi de + çoğul fiil: **Both** of them **are** doctors.
- **either (of)** = ikisinden biri / (olumsuzda) hiçbiri: You can take **either** one.
- **neither (of)** = hiçbiri (olumlu fiille): **Neither** of them came.
- both ... and / either ... or / neither ... nor

topics.title: another / other / others / the other
topics.notes:
- **another** + tekil = bir başka (ek): Can I have **another** coffee?
- **other** + çoğul = diğer (belirsiz): **Other** people think differently.
- **others** = diğerleri (isimsiz): Some like tea, **others** like coffee.
- **the other** = ikisinden öteki / belirli diğeri: One is red, **the other** is blue.
- **the others** = geri kalanların hepsi.

topics.title: -ed / -ing sıfatlar
topics.notes:
- **-ed** → kişinin hissi: I'm **bored**. / She's **interested**.
- **-ing** → hissi veren şey: The film is **boring**. / The book is **interesting**.
- ⚠️ I'm boring = Ben sıkıcıyım (başkalarını sıkıyorum)!

topics.title: so / such (a)
topics.notes:
- **so + sıfat/zarf**: It was **so cold**. / He spoke **so fast**.
- **such (a/an) + (sıfat) + isim**: It was **such a cold day**. / They're **such nice people**.
- Sonuç: so ... **that** / such ... **that**: It was so cold **that** we stayed home.

topics.title: Dönüşlü zamirler (myself, yourself…) + each other
topics.notes:
| Özne | Dönüşlü |
|---|---|
| I / you | myself / yourself |
| he / she / it | himself / herself / itself |
| we / you / they | ourselves / yourselves / themselves |

- Özne ve nesne aynı kişi: I cut **myself**. / Enjoy **yourselves**!
- by myself = tek başıma. **each other** = birbirini: They love **each other**.

topics.title: the …-er, the …-er (B1+)
topics.notes:
- İki şey birlikte artar: **The more** you practise, **the better** you get.
- **The sooner, the better.** (Ne kadar erken o kadar iyi.)

topics.title: although / even though / despite / in spite of / however
topics.notes:
- **although / even though + cümle**: **Although** it was raining, we went out.
- **despite / in spite of + isim / -ing**: **Despite the rain**, we went out. / Despite **being** tired...
- **however** = ancak, yeni cümle başında virgülle: It was raining. **However**, we went out.

topics.title: during / for / while
topics.notes:
- **during + isim** (ne zaman): **during** the film
- **for + süre** (ne kadar): **for** two hours
- **while + cümle**: **while** I was eating

topics.title: Sonuç ve sebep: so / therefore / because of / due to / as
topics.notes:
- Sebep: **because + cümle** / **because of / due to + isim** / **as / since + cümle** (başta)
- Sonuç: **so** (gündelik), **therefore** (resmî)
- **Because of the traffic**, I was late. = I was late **because** the traffic was bad.

topics.title: Sıralama: first / then / after that / finally / eventually
topics.notes:
- **First (of all)**, ... **Then** / **Next**, ... **After that**, ... **Finally**, ...
- **eventually** = sonunda (uzun bir süreçten sonra): He **eventually** found a job.
- **at first** (başta) ≠ **first** (ilk olarak): **At first** I didn't like it, but now I love it.

Ahmet had always wondered what kind of man his grandfather had been.
He sat on the dusty floor and started reading.
In one letter, his grandfather had written to his grandmother: "I am working in Germany now. I will come back when I have saved enough money."
Ahmet's grandmother told him later that his grandfather had worked in a car factory for six years.
She said he had sent money home every month and that he had written a letter every week.
"Why didn't he ever talk about those years?" Ahmet asked.
His grandmother explained that it had been a very lonely time for him.
"He didn't speak German, and he missed us terribly," she said.
Ahmet felt sad.
He thought he should have asked his father more questions about his grandfather.
He might have learned these stories years ago.
That evening, he called his father and told him what he had found.
His father was quiet for a long time.
Then he said, "I haven't seen those letters for forty years. Can you bring them to me?"
The next weekend, the whole family sat together and read the letters.
For the first time, Ahmet felt that he really knew his grandfather.

sentences.t: Gül is forty-two years old, and she has been learning to swim for six months.
When she was a child, she lived in a small town in the middle of Anatolia, far from the sea.
There wasn't a swimming pool in the town, so she never learned.
Although she has lived in Antalya for fifteen years, she had never swum in the sea until this year.
"I used to sit on the beach and watch my children play in the water," she says.
"I was embarrassed, and to be honest, I was also afraid."
Last spring, her daughter persuaded her to try.
She found a course for adults at the local sports centre.
The first lesson was terrible.
"I couldn't even put my face in the water," she remembers.
"I nearly gave up after the second lesson."
But her teacher, a calm young man called Emre, told her not to worry.
He said that many adults had the same problem and that the most important thing was to relax.
So Gül kept going.
She has been going to the pool three times a week since April.
She has learned to float, and she can now swim twenty metres without stopping.
"I'm still getting used to breathing correctly," she laughs.
"But I'm not afraid anymore."
Her children are very proud of her.
Last weekend the whole family went to the beach, and for the first time Gül swam in the sea with them.
"The water was cold and the waves were bigger than in the pool," she says.
"Despite that, it was one of the best days of my life."
Gül's next goal is to swim one kilometre before her next birthday.
"If you really want something," she says, "your age doesn't matter. The only thing you need is to start."

texts.title: Should We Ban Cars from the City Centre?

sentences.t: Did you read the news? The council wants to ban cars from the city centre.
Yes, I did. I think it's a great idea.
Really? I'm not so sure. Lots of people need their cars for work.
That's true, but the air in the centre is terrible because of the traffic.
I agree that pollution is a problem. However, public transport here isn't very good.
That's the point. If there are fewer cars, the buses will be faster.
Maybe. But what about shop owners? They might lose customers.
Actually, in many European cities, shops have more customers after the ban, because people walk more.
Hmm, I didn't know that. That must be because walking is more pleasant without traffic.
Exactly. And the city would be quieter and safer for children.
I still think they should improve the buses first.
So do I. They should do both at the same time.
Well, at least we agree on something!
Despite our different opinions, we usually do.
